I5.quote: The electrochemical behavior and stability of Pt, Ti, TiN, and nano-porous carbon for implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) electrode application were investigated in a phosphate buffered saline solution.
I5.location: main, p. 1 (journal p. 4011), Abstract, first sentence

notes: Code electrochemical: the paper's hydrogen is electrochemical only. Supporting passages: 'Possible reactions that may occur during the cathodic pulsing are: (i) gas evolution, e.g. H2; (ii) adsorption of H and formation of hydrides (e.g. TiH2) and hydroxides' (main, p. 7, journal p. 4017, Section 3.4); 'smooth Ti and TiN electrodes showed evidence for H adsorption' (main, p. 10, journal p. 4020, Conclusions). H is inferred from darkening of the surface and not measured as uptake. Nano-porous carbon (Marketech) is tested as an electrode in PBS; only a qualitative 'extremely high surface area' is stated, no surface area value. is_retracted is false in record.json; not a review; no sign of retraction in the text.
